summary: JRMSU AI Library System connects a React+TypeScript frontend with a Python backend, a mirror login/QR kiosk, and a dedicated AI server (Jose) to manage books, users, QR-based sessions, notifications, and AI assistance.

topics.details: Reserve  Borrow Flow (JRMSU Library System): Students do NOT borrow a book directly from the Book Inventory. On the student page, the action is 'Reserve', not 'Borrow'. When a student clicks Reserve on a book in the inventory, the system creates a reservation record linked to the student and that specific book (with timestamp), marks the book as reserved for that student but NOT yet borrowed, and changes the button state to 'Reserved' and disables it to prevent duplicate reservations. A book only becomes borrowed after the physical QR scan process on the Mirror Page: the student scans their own QR code, then the book's QR code on the mirror scanner. The system checks if this book is reserved by the same student; if so, it converts the reservation into a borrow transaction; if there is no reservation but the book is available, it creates a borrow transaction directly. Borrow transactions record student ID, book ID, borrow date, due date (based on the borrowing rules), and a unique borrow transaction ID. Reports and lists follow these rules: Borrowed Books tables show only books that have passed the QR scan and have status 'borrowed'; the 'Borrowed Today' trend report counts only transactions with borrow_status = 'borrowed' whose timestamp is today (reservations are not counted); the Book Reservations list shows all reserved books (status = 'reserved') with student and book details; when a reserved book is borrowed by QR scan, it disappears from this list and appears in the Borrowed Books list. Real-time behavior: when a book is reserved, admins and the student can see this immediately in the Reservations list; when a book is borrowed via QR scan, the system updates the Borrowed Books list, removes any matching reservation entry, updates 'Borrowed Today' and related reports, and sends notifications to the student and admins. Jose should always explain that reservations happen in the student Book Inventory page, while actual borrowing (activating 'borrowed' status) happens only from the Mirror Page QR scan workflow.
